_help: What's New popup and bell. Add the newest update FIRST with a new unique id; every user sees it once when they next open the app, and the bell stays in the header for 7 days. Fields: id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, items [{icon, title, text}]. Changes are picked up without a restart.

updates.title: Major AI Engine & Platform Upgrades
updates.summary: AI Take-Profit Re-Entry, Selective Kelly Sizing, Mobile Admin, and Confluence Enhancements are now live!

items.title: AI Take-Profit & Instant Bot Re-Entry
items.text: Clicking 'Take Profit' now secures your gains as an AI Take-Profit, preserving AI badges and instantly unlocking the bot so it can re-enter on subsequent pullbacks and new signals.

items.title: Selective Kelly EV Position Sizing
items.text: Auto Kelly sizing is now completely optional! We added a dedicated toggle in Settings → Sizing & Limits. Keep it OFF for strict, predictable contract limits, or turn it ON for algorithmic EV sizing.

items.title: Mobile-First Admin Console
items.text: Completely redesigned admin console optimized for mobile devices (including iPhone 17 Pro Max) with sticky KPI chips, bottom sheets, and instant user management.

items.title: Enhanced Confluence & Chop Defense
items.text: Refined weighted confluence engine incorporating CVD volume velocity and ADX volatility to prevent chop bleed and eliminate false breakout entries.

items.title: Adaptive Market Regimes (Auto 2.0)
items.text: Intelligent regime switching automatically routes entries between Momentum Surfer, Ambush, and Capital Guard based on live market conditions.

items.title: Tactical Multi-Entry DCA
items.text: Automated 2nd and 3rd entry dip accumulation when favorable contract pricing occurs with 4+ minutes remaining on the contract.

items.title: Sub-Second Execution & Visual Inspection
items.text: Real-time strike countdown timers, sub-second order fills, and an interactive trade breakdown modal for inspecting execution metrics.

items.title: AI panel shows YOUR signal
items.text: AI Intelligence now uses your own trading style and signal source, and tells you exactly what the bot will do next: buy, hold or pass, and why.

items.title: New EDGE reading
items.text: EDGE shows how much cheaper a contract is than the model thinks it's worth, after Kalshi's fee. Green means the price is in your favour.

items.title: Edge Guard (on by default)
items.text: The bot now skips trades that are overpriced after fees. Adjust it in Settings → Confidence Filters, where you can also set a minimum edge.

items.title: Daily limits now enforced
items.text: Your Max Daily Trades and Max Daily Risk settings now stop the bot for the rest of the day once reached.

items.title: Real strategy stats
items.text: Strategy Performance in Settings shows each strategy's actual win rate over the last 30 days, not estimates.

items.title: Faster chart + live trades
items.text: A lighter, faster price chart with bubbles showing trades happening on Kalshi in real time.
